# Aegisbox

> Unbreakable, Zero-Escape AI Execution Sandbox & Adversarial Range Engine.

## Core Capabilities
- MicroVM Hardware Isolation: Boots lightweight microVM instances in ~100ms using libkrun on Apple Hypervisor Framework (macOS) and KVM (Linux).
- Ephemeral COW Shadow Workspaces: Clones target repositories into isolated overlay snapshots; changes require explicit approval before applying to host disk.
- Cockpit Visualizer Desktop: Native Go/Wails desktop UI visualizing active VM sandboxes, live filesystem deltas, and telemetry.
- Adversarial Range Engine: Automated red-team evaluation suite testing against synthetic prompt injections, PTY hijacks, and escape vectors.

## CLI Usage
- `aegisbox exec -- <command>`: Executes command inside an ephemeral microVM shadow workspace.
- `aegisbox diff`: Displays git delta created inside the shadow workspace.
- `aegisbox approve`: Merges verified changes from shadow workspace back to the host repo.
- `aegisbox daemon start|stop|status`: Controls background microVM warm-pool daemon.
- `aegisbox cockpit`: Launches native desktop visualizer GUI.
- `aegisbox range run --all`: Executes full adversarial testbed matrix.
- `aegisbox doctor`: Verifies hypervisor entitlements and virtualization drivers.

## Sockets & Paths
- Daemon Socket: `~/.aegisbox/aegisboxd.sock`
- Workspaces: `~/.aegisbox/workspaces/`
- Documentation: `docs/knowledge-base/03-aegisbox.md` in repo `spanreed`
